title: City Page Content

fields.label: Start here
fields.message: Safe editing: update only the fields in this screen to create a local version. The page design, layout, and shared content stay intact. Required fields power the opening section visitors see first.

fields.label: City name (editor reference)
fields.name: city_name
fields.instructions: The city name used to identify this page in WordPress and in localized copy. Example: Dallas.

fields.label: Hero eyebrow (small line above headline)
fields.name: hero_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Short uppercase-style context displayed above the main headline. Example: DALLAS SEO AGENCY.

fields.label: Hero headline (large opening text)
fields.name: hero_title
fields.instructions: The large headline at the top of the page. Keep it concise. Limited inline HTML such as   is supported.

fields.label: Hero summary (text below headline)
fields.name: hero_subtitle
fields.instructions: One short supporting paragraph shown immediately below the hero headline.

fields.label: Results heading
fields.name: results_heading
fields.instructions:
Use
for a deliberate line break.

fields.label: How these overrides work
fields.message: These fields change only the matching numbered card in the shared case-study section. Leave a field blank to keep the standard shared copy. The number refers to the card’s fixed position on the live page, so review the page before changing one.

fields.label: Metric-card guidance
fields.message: Each note appears below the metric on its matching numbered case-study card. Leave blank to retain the shared wording.

fields.label: Review-card guidance
fields.message: These fields edit only the matching numbered review card. Use the context field for the location or business type; leave any field blank to preserve the shared review copy.

fields.label: FAQ section mode
fields.name: faq_mode
fields.instructions: Choose “Custom FAQ rows” to add, remove, or reorder the questions below. Choose “Hide” to remove the entire FAQ section.

fields.label: FAQ section heading
fields.name: faq_title
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank to keep the standard heading.

fields.label: FAQ section introduction
fields.name: faq_sub
fields.instructions: Optional short paragraph shown below the FAQ heading.

fields.label: FAQ questions and answers
fields.name: faqs
fields.instructions: Drag rows to reorder them. Removing a row removes that question from this page when Custom FAQ rows is selected above.

fields.label: Fallback SEO title (Yoast takes priority)
fields.name: seo_title
fields.instructions: Use only when Yoast SEO is not setting a title for this page. Keep it around 50–60 characters.

fields.label: Fallback meta description (Yoast takes priority)
fields.name: seo_description
fields.instructions: Use only when Yoast SEO is not setting a meta description. Aim for one clear sentence, about 150–160 characters.

description: Editable location copy for reusable City Pages.
